E1.evidence: Public issue with a reproducer and log: "ros2 run demo_nodes_cpp talker_loaned_message" printing "[rclcpp]: Currently used middleware can't loan messages. Local allocator will be used." Maintainer MiguelCompany: "After #568 is merged the only requirement for LoanedMessage to work would be for the data type to be plain." (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_fastrtps/issues/579#issuecomment-1036153357). Merged PR ros2/rmw_fastrtps#568 (19d141d6).

E2.evidence: The loan refusal is decided entirely by rmw_fastrtps's own policy, independent of the application: at the parent revision b56cd5fe the publisher is created with "writer_qos.data_sharing().off();" when middleware-default QoS is not requested, and then "bool has_data_sharing = DataSharingKind::OFF != writer_qos.data_sharing().kind();\n  rmw_publisher->can_loan_messages = has_data_sharing && info->type_support_->is_plain();". Any correct application requesting a loan for any plain type gets the same result. PR #568 description: "The only requirement on the Fast DDS API in order for loans to be used is that the type is plain. This PR allows calling the loan APIs when data-sharing is OFF." The fix changes only the rmw_fastrtps computation of can_loan_messages (publisher.cpp in rmw_fastrtps_cpp and rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp, rmw_take.cpp in rmw_fastrtps_shared_cpp); no declared interface between the application/rclcpp and the rmw changes.

E3.evidence: Would be PAIR (application borrows a loaned message from the middleware for publishing). Not decisive because the case stops at E2.

E4.evidence: Observed: "Currently used middleware can't loan messages. Local allocator will be used." while publishing continues (fallback).

notes: The reported behaviour is a capability limitation of rmw_fastrtps (loans tied to data-sharing, which the rmw turns off by default), not a mismatch of an assumption between the application and the middleware; the composition kept working with a local allocator. Before #568 the maintainer's workaround was deployment QoS configuration (XML data_sharing AUTOMATIC plus RMW_FASTRTPS_USE_QOS_FROM_XML=1), which is QoS configuration rather than name binding. Related side effects discussed in PR #568 (rclcpp Subscription::handle_loaned_message not accounting topic statistics, fixed in ros2/rclcpp#1927; a test using std::launch::deferred, ros2/rclcpp#1940) are separate compositions and are not conditions of this case.
